about.label: 01 / About Me
about.p1: I'm a Full Stack Developer focused on Frontend development. My work goes beyond writing code: I turn real-world challenges into digital experiences that are intuitive, functional, and visually engaging.
about.p2: I have hands-on experience building web applications with React, Next.js, Angular, Vue, Node.js, and PHP. My work includes interface development, API integration, feature implementation, and frontend-backend communication.
about.p3: I believe performance and visual experience should go hand in hand. I work with component-based architecture, Styled Components, Material UI, Chakra UI, and Tailwind CSS, as well as advanced animations using GSAP, ScrollTrigger, and SVG.
about.p4: I also work on freelance projects, ranging from landing pages and corporate websites to custom web applications. I take part in the entire process: understanding requirements, development, optimization, and deployment.
about.card1_desc: Clean code, consistent architecture, and scalable solutions built with best practices.
about.card2_desc: Intuitive interfaces, distinctive visual identities, and a strong focus on user experience.
about.card3_desc: Speed, accessibility, SEO, and technology working together to support business growth.

projects.p3_result: A digital experience designed to showcase solutions, strengthen brand identity, and turn visitors into potential customers.
